profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Stripe
profile.summary: Full stack software developer who loves to design everything from the database to the front end CSS. Focused on creating reusable, maintainable, and clean code.  Loves to write tests to avoid head banging in the future.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Reduced MySQL database load over 95% by managing indexes, re-writing queries, and restructuring application code
- Drove architectural discussions across engineering department, working with all stakeholders to ensure the code bases' long term sustainability
- Implemented critical, high visibility projects including the order fulfillment workflow and facility management tooling leading to over $3 million in annualized cost savings
- Coordinated product managers, engineering managers, and senior engineers on over 25 projects to find better solutions with less long term engineering effort

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Relational Databases · Web Development · SQL

positions.title: Contributor
positions.description:
- ripozo: Created an open source package for quickly creating Hypermedia/REST APIs. Framework and database independent. https://github.com/vertical-knowledge/ripozo
- Flask-User: Bug fix for url redirects on login
- cqlengine: Added feature for performing lightweight transactions on the Cassandra Database via the cqlengine ORM

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Relational Databases · Web Development · SQL · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Championed adoption of test-driven development and developed a strong test framework, leading to a 600% increase in test coverage
- Worked with product owners, customers, and other stakeholders to identify root problems and refine requirements
- Identified and resolved critical tech debt by measuring the impact, identifying the root cause, triaging, and implementing solutions
- Mentored and developed a team of 5 engineers, helping them to amplify their strengths, mitigate their weaknesses, and explore their curiosities
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · PostgreSQL · Relational Databases · React.js · Python (Programming Language) · Web Development · SQL · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and rewrote analytics pipeline required to handle more than 7000 events per second
- Introduced Docker to both local development and the production environment using AWS ECS
- Introduced Terraform for provisioning and scaling cloud resources
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Terraform · PostgreSQL · Relational Databases · Java · Web Development · SQL · Agile Methodologies · Google BigQuery · Ansible · Amazon Kinesis

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and built a horizontally scaleable data processing pipeline using a microservice architecture, Kafka, Flask, Ripozo, Postgres, Redis, Cassandra, ElasticSearch and websockets.
- Developed continuous deployment strategy using Docker, Mesos, and Marathon
- Open source data-mining via Python
- Developed company registry web application using Django, Python, and Twitter Bootstrap
positions.insights: Skills: Relational Databases · Web Development · SQL · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
Developed a complete C# testing application that can find and selectively run any unit test on the system and display its result
Developed a GUI framework for running load tests that allows the user to create and run load scenarios
Wrote all FDA auditable documentation, including: user requirements, software design document and user manual

positions.title: Team Leader
positions.description:
Developing odorless, biodegradable shoe prototype to determine feasibility
Performing market research through the use of consumer surveys to investigate economic potential 
Engaging CWRU Materials Department, Early Stage Partners, Tactivex, and Natureworks LLC to develop business plan

positions.title: Economic Research Intern
positions.description:
Programmed a series of VBA macros to automatically update, clean, format and sort multiple 20,000+ Excel data sets
Determined optimal savings level to smooth consumption using 6,000,000+ data set on income and expense volatility
Developed and presented weekly reports to Neighborhood Stabilization Team on best-practice asset creation methods
Designed Microinsurance program developed to simultaneously prevent need for predatory lenders and generate savings

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Responsible for creating weekly, hour long lesson plans covering the application of concepts learned in lecture
Maintaining Excel database to record and track student's homework, quiz, and test grades
Created and proctored weekly quizzes designed to help students understand the fundamentals of materials engineering

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Designed a sensor to detect the texture of a surface for a prosthetic limb

positions.title: Orientation Leader
positions.description:
Assisted in registering, moving in, developing class schedules, and acclimating over 950 freshman and 50 transfer students
Responsible for leading diverse groups of 8 to10 incoming freshman
Coordinated advising meetings, informational sessions, and social events between freshmen, parents, faculty, and staff

projects.title: ripozo
projects.description: Ripozo is an open source project for quickly creating Hypermedia/RESTful APIs in python.  It is framework and database independent.  It is also capable of delivering a multitude of Hypermedia formats (SIREN, HAL, etc.) by simply setting the Content-Type header appropriately,
